day_shape: 109 items: US CENTCOM strikes Iranian boats and missile sites despite ceasefire, IDF hits 70+ Hezbollah targets across Lebanon, Khamenei issues lengthy Hajj message vowing American bases will lose regional safe haven, Pezeshkian orders end to ~90-day internet blackout.

threads.label: US strikes Iran amid ceasefire
threads.summary: US Central Command struck Iranian boats laying mines and missile launch sites in southern Iran, citing troop self-defence. IRGC said it forced an MQ-9, RQ-4 and F-35 from Iranian airspace and reserved the right to reciprocal response to any ceasefire violation.

threads.label: IDF escalates against Hezbollah in Lebanon
threads.summary: IDF struck 70+ Hezbollah infrastructure sites using ~85 munitions across Lebanon including Tyre, after Netanyahu ordered intensified strikes following a surge in Hezbollah drone attacks. Eleven IDF soldiers have been killed in Lebanon since the ceasefire began; Zamir and Smotrich reportedly threatened to strike Beirut.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear and Hormuz negotiations
threads.summary: WSJ mediators told Jerusalem Post that US-Iran talks have slowed over nuclear and sanctions relief; Iranian officials are in Qatar for Hormuz discussions and Trump said Abraham Accords accession is 'mandatory' for Muslim states involved. JPost reported Iran may consider transferring its 60% enriched uranium to China; IRIB denied an Al-Arabiya report of a 14-point draft MoU.

threads.label: Khamenei Hajj message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a lengthy pilgrimage-season message asserting 'America will no longer have a safe point' for bases in the region and claiming the 'Zionist regime's' end is near. Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed parallel framing of victory in the 'third imposed war' and invited Islamic governments to cooperation.

threads.label: Iranian domestic governance moves
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian ordered the reopening of international internet access after a near-90-day blackout, with the government spokesman confirming implementation imminent. The spokesman also addressed petrol consumption targets, medicine prices and overtime rules, while the judiciary announced the execution of Gholamreza Khani Shekrab for alleged spying for Israel.

threads.label: Iranian regional posture statements
threads.summary: Iran's ambassador to Russia and IRGC-linked commanders told Defa Press that Persian Gulf countries cannot rely on US protection and that 'Americans will have no place in the Persian Gulf', warning the next war would be regional. IRIB cited Haaretz claiming Gulf states are exploring defence cooperation with Iran.
